SBI Life Smart Lifetime Saver ek traditional (bonus wala) plan hai.

Agar ab premium bharna possible nahi hai,
to policy turant break hona zaroori nahi hota 👍

📌 Is plan mein:
🔹 Minimum kuch saal premium pay ho chuka ho (usually 2 full years)
🔹 To policy Paid-Up mode mein ja sakti hai

👉 Paid-Up hone par:
✔ Policy continue rehti hai
❌ Future premiums nahi bharne padte
❌ Lekin sum assured aur bonus proportionately kam ho jaate hain

📌 Grace period ke baad kya option best hai,
ye policy document dekh kar hi confirm hota hai.

comments.text:
T-Bill aur G-Sec pure investment products hote hain.

🔹 Inme government guarantee hoti hai
🔹 Return fixed / market-linked hota hai
🔹 Life insurance cover nahi hota

Agar investor ko kuch ho jata hai,
to sirf invested amount + interest milta hai —
koi extra protection nahi.

SBI Life Smart Lifetime Saver jaise plans ka purpose alag hota hai:

🔹 Zindagi bhar ka life insurance cover
🔹 Long-term discipline ke saath saving
🔹 Company ke profit se bonus (agar declared ho)

📌 Agar policyholder ko beech me kuch hota hai,
to family ko death benefit milta hai,
jo invested amount se kaafi zyada hota hai.

👉 Isliye T-Bill / G-Sec ko
life insurance plan se direct compare karna sahi nahi.

Sahi comparison hamesha goal ke hisaab se hota hai:
– Protection chahiye → Insurance
– Sirf parking  → T-Bill / G-Sec

> Investment paisa badhata hai,
insurance family ko bachata hai.
